optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Enterprise Knowledge Base

professionalSummary.text: Maintains per-customer load model forecasting search queries and sync volume using user counts and document growth, recalibrated monthly against platform metrics warehouse.
professionalSummary.witness: Kept the per-customer load model that predicts search queries and sync volume from user counts and document growth; every month I recalibrated it against the platform metrics warehouse.

experienceHighlights.text: Transforms quarterly forecasts into index-shard and storage plans presented at quarterly planning meetings with platform and customer teams.
experienceHighlights.witness: Turned each quarter's forecast into an index-shard and storage plan that the platform team and I took to the quarterly planning meeting.

experienceHighlights.text: Reduced capacity-related incidents from 7 to 2 per half-year by implementing a shard rebalancing plan, meeting the published incident baseline of 7 incidents per half-year.
experienceHighlights.witness: Capacity-related incidents fell from 7 in the first half of the year to 2 in the second half after the shard rebalancing plan was applied, as counted in the platform incident register against its published baseline of 7 incidents per half-year.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provides a year of capacity-related incident register with baseline and rebalancing plan markers, and one cycle's assumptions note with export identifiers for tracing.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: a year of the incident register filtered to capacity-related incidents (with the baseline and the rebalancing plan marked) and one cycle's assumptions note; export identifiers are included for tracing.

skills.text: Capacity planning, forecasting, incident reduction, cross-functional collaboration, documentation of assumptions.
skills.witness: Kept the per-customer load model... Turned each quarter's forecast... Capacity-related incidents fell... Took capacity changes through the quarterly planning meeting... Kept an assumptions note per cycle...

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's direct experience with all requirements except for explicit documentation of the 'who approved what' in requirement req_251fe9ac4ad0, which is partially supported by the mention of platform lead approval but lacks full traceability.

decisionBoundary.statement: All requirements are supported or partially supported, but evidence for requirement req_251fe9ac4ad0 lacks full traceability of approvals.

role.roleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Enterprise Knowledge Base

evidence.text: Kept the per-customer load model that predicts search queries and sync volume from user counts and document growth; every month I recalibrated it against the platform metrics warehouse.
Kept an assumptions note per cycle covering the model inputs, the fact that bulk document imports sat outside the forecast, and what the next cycle inherited.
Turned each quarter's forecast into an index-shard and storage plan that the platform team and I took to the quarterly planning meeting.
evidence.notes: Directly addresses turning forecast into plans with platform team.

evidence.text: Capacity-related incidents fell from 7 in the first half of the year to 2 in the second half after the shard rebalancing plan was applied, as counted in the platform incident register against its published baseline of 7 incidents per half-year.
evidence.notes: Directly addresses incident reduction against baseline.

evidence.text: Reference call with the former platform lead: the incident counts are from the platform incident register, the shard rebalancing plan was the candidate's proposal, and the employment dates match.
evidence.notes: Confirms incident data source and candidate's role in plan.

evidence.text: Took capacity changes through the quarterly planning meeting with the platform and customer teams; the platform lead approved shard changes and the customer teams handled communication with their accounts.
evidence.notes: Mentions platform lead approval but lacks full traceability of approvals.
